bounded_limitations.consequence: Evidence is behavioral_evidence_only and cannot establish absolute size accuracy.
These fixtures support decode, identity, repeatability, status, and reason-code evidence, but not acquisition-condition conclusions.
The embedded local creation time is retained without inventing a UTC offset; this RGB display asset is excluded from grayscale measurement regression.
The fixtures verify metadata absence handling, not behavior across PNG color-management combinations.
bounded_limitations.observed: No representative fixture contains gAMA, sRGB, or iCCP metadata.
